methodologyNotes: Scope: residential sectional garage door openers sold as complete head-unit kits (motor + rail + remote) in the US, spanning belt-drive, chain-drive, screw-drive and wall-mount (jackshaft) drive types. priceUsd = US MSRP / manufacturer list price in USD at launch; where the maker does not publish an MSRP, use the prevailing Home Depot / Lowe's / Amazon list price and note it in priceNote; null only if no primary-source US price is obtainable. specKeys units & null policy: motor_hp (string, rated horsepower or HP-comparable rating exactly as published, e.g. '3/4', '1-1/4 HPc'; null if not stated); drive_type (string enum: belt | chain | screw | wall-mount/jackshaft | direct-drive); motor_type (string: DC | AC; null if unstated); wifi_smart (bool, native Wi-Fi/app control built in — true only if integrated, not via add-on kit); smart_platform (string, app/ecosystem name e.g. myQ, Aladdin Connect; null if none); battery_backup (bool, integrated rechargeable backup that operates the door during outages); camera (bool, integrated camera); led_lumens (numeric, rated light output in lumens; null if only a watt-equivalent or no figure published); max_door_height_ft (numeric, max door height in feet supported out of the box, before extension kit; null if unstated); belt_chain_warranty (string, motor/drive warranty as published, e.g. 'lifetime motor & belt'; null if unstated); release (YYYY or YYYY-MM). Booleans are never null (default false when the maker explicitly omits the feature). HP ratings are kept as published strings because vendors use non-comparable 'HPc'/'HPS' equivalence marketing rather than true motor horsepower; do not numerically coerce. Research methodology: primary sources = manufacturer product pages (chamberlain.com, liftmaster.com, geniecompany.com/store.geniecompany.com, ryobitools.com, sommer-usa.com/sommer.eu, skylinkstore.com); secondary/corroboration = Home Depot, Lowe's, Walmart, Amazon, dealer sites. Prices sourced from major US retailers where manufacturer does not publish MSRP. LiftMaster models are dealer-channel and do not publish consumer MSRPs; the 8500W and 87504-267 prices come from authorized dealer listing pages. Sommer 1042V is the Direct Drive 550 product line; the 'Synoris' name in the candidate refers to the broader Synoris/Direct Drive product family marketed by Sommer USA. The Skylink AT-1622BK is the earlier SKU designation for what Skylink now calls the ATR-1622BK; specifications are identical.
